snippet.title: Star Voyager (NES) Gameplay 240p | No Commentary - Acclaim, Sept 1987 (Original Hardware, Composite)
snippet.description:
Star Voyager was released for Nintendo's classic 8-bit NES console in September 1987. All audio/visual elements copyright 1987, Acclaim. Music composed by ?

https://nesguide.com/games/star-voyager/

This video was produced for NESguide.com - a website that attempts to organize the NES catalog and make it easy to explore. Gameplays from this channel are featured throughout the NESguide website to showcase the original basic mechanics and audio/visual design of each title. Thank you for your continued support of this project, since 2007!


ABOUT STAR VOYAGER (NES)

When those who were left in your civilization boarded CosmoStation Noah, they thought they were headed for safety. Little did they know they would end up under intergalactic seige. Surrounded indefinitely by Molak Wardrivers. Somehow, someone must rid Spiral Galaxy IX of this Molok flotilla. Perhaps that someone is you...

AKA: Cosmo Genesis
